reviewer: Arena.ai competent assistant under user direction
policy: Require the requested concepts, reject material factual errors, and reject pathological repetition even when keyword checks pass.

overrides.rationale: The answer states the correct inputs and outputs once but then repeats the same sentence until the token limit; this is not acceptable generated quality.

rationale: The 264137 learned parameters change Qwen logits and improve manually reviewed held-out paraphrases from 1/24 to 13/24 with no shelf lookup. This is real parametric adaptation. It is not deployable because 11/24 target answers still fail and the learned gate corrupts 2/8 unrelated held-out controls.
limitations: One held-out paraphrase per topic and eight unrelated controls are bounded evidence. The adapter can memorize training trajectories, and this experiment does not prove broad intelligence or safe unrestricted use.
